description: This file defines the interface for a NotificationHandler class responsible for managing and dispatching notifications within a TR-069 host interface component. It declares static methods for singleton instance management, callback registration, and various notification push operations, as well as private static members related to callback handling and notification queue.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods to push different types of notifications and manage notification callbacks within the host interface.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NotificationHandler.

methods.name: GetNotificationQueue
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the GAsyncQueue used for notification management.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked upon notification updates.

methods.name: pushValueChangeNotification
methods.description: Pushes a notification indicating a change in a value, based on provided event data.

methods.name: pushKeyValueNotification
methods.description: Pushes a key-value notification to specified destination.

methods.name: push_device_mgmt_notifications
methods.description: Pushes device management related notifications, including download status, system time, etc.

methods.name: push_device_deepsleep_notifications
methods.description: Pushes deep sleep mode status notifications.
